text:
ana: quick thread 1: proposing a small redesign of the time-range presets + p95 hover tooltip: add a compact preset bar above the timepicker for 5m/15m/1h/24h and a persistent "Sampled" indicator on the heatmap legend when sampling is active. main goal: make it obvious when values are approximated vs exact

mike: yes on the sampled badge. also ask: can the preset bar show a subtle active-state count (e.g., 1m, 15m) and keyboard-focus outline? power users use keyboard nav a lot :keyboard:

sara: accessibility nits: tooltip needs aria-describedby linking to a hidden paragraph that explains what p95 means and whether the number is sampled or full. keyboard users must be able to traverse heatmap cells and activate the tooltip with Enter/Space. visible focus styles are mandatory

lex: interaction idea 1: when hovering a heatmap bucket show a tiny context row under the tooltip with two quick actions: "Open traces" and "Pin to timeline". the pin attaches an annotation marker so you can compare across ranges

kevin: engineering constraints: prefer client-side indicators (badge + tooltip) and keep sampling calls debounced at 200-400ms. if we show quick-actions, keep them simple GETs to avoid expensive trace queries. also expose a feature flag `sampled_badge` for staged rollout

jamie: copy suggestions: tooltip header should read "p95 (estimated)" when sampling is on. for the preset bar, label the 24h preset as "1d" to save space. also suggest micro-copy under the sampled badge: "based on N samples" when available

toni: UX edge-case: when user is in compact vertical mode, the preset bar shouldn't push content down. propose overlay the presets on the timepicker drop-down instead of between panels

dev-bot: staging preview at https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/presets-sampling-a11y (expires in 72h) :rocket:

sara: color/contrast: ensure preset active state meets 4.5:1 if it's an interactive element. sampled badge should use an outline + filled icon pattern so color-blind users can still read state

ana: follow-up items: 1) update Figma with preset microstates + focus styles, 2) add aria-describedby text for p95 tooltip, 3) implement sampled badge + telemetry `sampled_badge_clicked`, 4) add keyboard docs to shortcuts page. I'll make the mocks and share by EOD. thanks! :thumbsup:
